skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the scientific basis of development strategy, characteristics, and content of development strategy.
Master the essence, process, methods, and tools for building development strategies for organizations, industries, regions, and national economic sectors.
Integrate knowledge and analyze strategic content, work in teams, read, write, present, and engage in professional discussions.
Develop critical thinking, creativity, professional ethics, social responsibility, and self-study habits.
Demonstrate leadership, professional attitude, respect, and strict adherence to regulations.
